findings.description: body_consistency() in report.py fails to re-derive the composer pass-invariant for environment preconditions (scope_adapter == "degraded" and code_search_enabled == False for live-tier gates). compose_verdict() in verdict.py forces verdict = FAIL (with APPARATUS_FAILURE or SERVICE_DISABLED_DURING_MEASUREMENT) under these conditions. The module docstring claims one-way derivation is necessary because apparatus failures live at top level rather than in rows; however, environment.scope_adapter and environment.code_search_enabled ARE recorded in document["environment"]. When a report with scope_adapter: "degraded" or code_search_enabled: false is hand-edited to record verdict: "pass" and gates[].verdict: "pass", body_consistency() returns consistent=True and derived_verdict="pass", causing context_eval check to exit 0 on a degraded/disabled run. Verified by running: python3 -c "import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, \"packages/context-eval/src\"); from pathlib import Path; from context_eval.__main__ import _check; from context_eval import report; doc = report.read_report(\"docs/evaluation/semantic-context/report.json\"); doc[\"verdict\"] = \"pass\"; doc.pop(\"fail_reasons\", None); doc[\"environment\"][\"scope_adapter\"] = \"degraded\"; doc[\"corpus\"][\"cases_scored\"] = 19; for g in doc[\"gates\"]: g[\"verdict\"] = \"pass\"; g[\"min_index_tier\"] = \"none\"; g[\"measured\"] = {\"hit_at_k\": 1.0}; g.pop(\"fail_reasons\", None); for c in doc[\"per_consumer\"]: c[\"verdict\"] = \"pass\"; c[\"metrics\"] = {\"answer_coverage_semantic\": 1.0, \"answer_coverage_baseline\": 1.0, \"evidence_density_semantic\": 1.0, \"evidence_density_baseline\": 1.0, \"steps_to_evidence_semantic\": 1.0, \"steps_to_evidence_baseline\": 1.0}; c.pop(\"fail_reasons\", None); for case in doc[\"cases\"]: case[\"scored\"] = True; case.pop(\"unscored_reason\", None); tmp = Path(\"/tmp/degraded_pass.json\"); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(doc)); print(\"exit:\", _check(report_path=tmp, corpus_root=Path(\"packages/context-eval/corpus\"), expect_digest=True)); tmp.unlink()" which output exit: 0.
findings.resolution: Update body_consistency() in report.py to check document["environment"]["scope_adapter"] == "degraded" and (for gates requiring live tier) document["environment"]["code_search_enabled"] is False as body failures.
